insights.one_liner: Zaandam biscuit and chocolate maker founded in 1886, part of global snacks group pladis, and an IND recognised sponsor.

culture.text: Calls itself a classic Dutch company in an international setting, with 300+ staff working on Verkade, Sultana, Godiva and McVitie's.
Staff often studied business, economics and marketing at the Amsterdam University of Applied Sciences, VU and Inholland.

open.text: Koninklijke Verkade N.V. is an IND recognised visa sponsor.

worth_knowing.text: Owned since 2014 by Yildiz Holding, through pladis, which has 36 factories in 13 countries and over 26,000 staff.
